skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply theoretical knowledge to practical real estate activities such as business operations, government management, and professional practices like brokerage, valuation, and property management.
Develop skills in searching, collecting, and analyzing reliable information, working independently, and managing time effectively.
Enhance communication skills in both verbal and written forms for professional activities, including the use of foreign languages and IT skills.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently, take responsibility in group work, and show a sense of responsibility in personal tasks.
Show the ability to plan and utilize appropriate resources to complete research topics.
Develop the ability to present issues and defend personal viewpoints.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the workplace, and maintain academic integrity.
Enhance multi-dimensional thinking, planning, and organizing research activities.
Identify and solve real-world problems based on acquired knowledge and skills.
Conduct independent research and prepare a final report.
